run_profiler_script: run the profiler script to plot AAE and EPE error metrics from result.txt
plot_AAE_vs_beta: plot AAE error according to beta value grouped by haze contrast levels
plot_EPE_vs_beta: plot EPE error according to beta value grouped by haze contrast levels
plot_EPE_vs_contrast: plot EPE error according to contrast value grouped by beta levels
parse_result_txt: parse result.txt to extract beta, contrast, AAE, and EPE values into lists
